placements.title: slug generation must resolve to a committable slug even without an explicit id
placements.frame: when the primary id-generation path is unavailable or an explicit id is omitted, does the deterministic fallback still guarantee a committable slug?
placements.why: src-1 establishes the precondition (no explicit id submitted) and src-2 states the pipeline's obligation to still produce a slug — via LLM id-gen or a deterministic slugify fallback — and commit successfully. Together these describe a durable design guarantee (dual-path slug generation ensuring the pipeline never stalls for lack of an id) rather than a one-off fact, so it's leaf-grain: future envelopes about this fallback behavior would keep feeding it. No existing leaf covers this theme.
